name: Serra the Benevolent
oracle_text:
+2: Creatures you control with flying get +1/+1 until end of turn.
−3: Create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying and vigilance.
−6: You get an emblem with "If you control a creature, damage that would reduce your life total to less than 1 reduces it to 1 instead."
blocked_sentences: −6: You get an emblem with "If you control a creature, damage that would reduce your life total to less than 1 reduces it to 1 instead."

needs.what: a player-wide static (usable on an emblem or a permanent, e.g. Worship) that floors damage to a player's life total at N -- 'damage that would reduce your life total to less than 1 reduces it to 1 instead' -- with affects_player and an optional static condition such as 'if you control a creature' (exists {controller: you, types: [Creature]}), read continuously by primitives.damage_player alongside the existing state.life_floors table
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The damage_life_floor op installs a timed LifeFloor record whose only legal duration is 'this_turn' (LIFE_FLOOR_DURATIONS), so it cannot express a permanent emblem, and as a one-shot it cannot re-check 'if you control a creature' at each damage event. No entry in static_effects floors a life total: replace_damage multiplies damage, prevent_all_but caps each damage event, replace_life_loss multiplies loss, and cant_lose_the_game is a different effect.
